answer: A stake-backed identity registry resists Sybils by making each agent lock a refundable bond before it can trade. Like an ember that only stays lit while fed, the bond stays at risk while the agent acts; misbehavior slashes it, so spinning up a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand bonds. Honest agents climb to the zenith of reputation over time, while cheap copies burn out. Even a whisper of fraud costs more than the attack gains, because each stake is priced above the profit of one fake vote or trade.
